about.story.heading: Why ChannelWatch
about.story.intro: I built ChannelWatch because I wanted one clear place to see what my Channels DVR was doing.
about.story.problem: The project began as a personal tool for tracking playback, recordings, disk space, and alerts. It grew through testing, feedback, and the everyday needs of people who run their own DVRs.
about.story.community: ChannelWatch is open source and still shaped by its community. Issues, discussions, and real setups help decide what gets improved next.
about.project.intro: ChannelWatch monitors Channels DVR activity and sends alerts when streams, recordings, disk space, or connectivity changes.
about.feature.2: Alerts for playback, recordings, DVR health, and disk space
about.feature.4: Discord, Telegram, email, Pushover, and other destinations
about.feature.7: Signed in-app updates with backup and rollback
